text1: In Journey Optimizer I design the email template for our summer sale. I lay out the layout, add a field that pulls in each customer's first name, and set up two image variants so the creative adapts to the recipient.
text2: With the email ready, I create a campaign and attach that email to it. I pick the audience of customers who should receive the message and choose when the campaign should run.
